therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Liposomal co-delivery of cytarabine and daunorubicin in synergistic 5:1 molar ratio
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with acute myeloid leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and myelodysplastic syndrome
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Effect on cardiac ventricular repolarization (QTcF prolongation)

results.effect_size: Maximum mean QTcF change of 8.0 msecs at 4 hours post-infusion
results.target_engagement_evidence: Pharmacokinetic data showed cytarabine Cmax 62200 ng/ml, daunorubicin Cmax 26000 ng/ml
biomarker_changes: Serum copper levels increased by mean 64.95 μg/dL from baseline
subgroup_findings: Complete response achieved in 8 out of 26 participants
safety_signals: Multiple infections including sepsis, pneumonia, meningitis
results.dose_information: CPX-351 administered during first induction treatment

context.duration: 21 days primary assessment, up to second induction if applicable
